exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Verb-te kudasaru".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! 動詞てくださる matches "Verb-te kudasaru".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is 動詞てくださる.
exercises.explanation: Expresses respect when someone does a favor for you; honorific verb form.
